lines.text: God tells Jonah to preach against Nineveh, but Jonah flees on a ship bound for Tarshish.
Jonah goes down to Gath, finds a ship, pays the fare, and goes aboard to sail away from the LORD.
The lot falls on Jonah, and he says he worships the LORD, who made the sea and dry land.
Jonah tells the sailors to cast him into the sea, but they first row hard toward Tyre.
